introTitle: Comrade, Override media_soviet\ Files Without Ever Touching Vanilla Data!
introBody:
Tired of backing up and overwriting core files inside [i]media_soviet\[/i] every time you try a shader, texture, or INI overhaul—or losing your changes whenever Steam verifies or patches the game?

By decree of the [b]Supreme Soviet Archival Directorate[/b], [b]MediaRedirector[/b] provides a non-destructive Virtual File System (VFS) that transparently redirects read-only [i]media_soviet\[/i] opens to local [i]media_overrides\[/i] packs and subscribed Steam Workshop override folders & [i].zip[/i] archives—complete with priority ordering and conflict detection in the [b]F9[/b] overlay (accessible right from the [b]Main Menu[/b]!).

[b]⚠️ EARLY ALPHA NOTICE:[/b] All discovered packs start [b]disabled by default[/b]—enable them manually in [b]F9 -> Media VFS[/b] and back up your saves before testing.
operatingSection:
[h1]Operating Media VFS (Main Menu & In-Game)[/h1][list]
[*] Press [b]F9[/b] on the [b]Main Menu[/b] (or in-game) to open [b]WRSR Tweaks [F9][/b] -> [b]Media VFS[/b] tab (or [b]Esc[/b] to close).
[*] [b]Enable Runtime Redirection:[/b] Live atomic toggle for VFS redirection.
[*] [b]Scan Steam Workshop Overrides:[/b] Discovers subscribed Workshop packs (both extracted folders and [i].zip[/i] archives) containing [i]media_soviet\[/i] or [i]override\[/i].
[*] [b]Manual-Only Pack List:[/b] Every newly discovered pack starts [b]disabled[/b]. Tick [b]Enabled[/b] and reorder priority with [b]Move Up[/b] / [b]Move Down[/b], then click [b]Save Config[/b] and relaunch.
[*] [b]Conflict Inspector:[/b] Expandable list showing every colliding [i]media_soviet\[/i] path, which pack won, and which packs were overridden.
[/list]
examplesSection:
[h1]For Modders: How to Support MediaRedirector[/h1][list]
[*] Package only your modified files under [code]media_soviet\...[/code] or [code]override\...[/code] (either directly in your Workshop folder or inside a [i].zip[/i] archive at root or one folder deep).
[*] Set [code]$ITEM_NAME "Your Mod Title"[/code] in [i]workshopconfig.ini[/i] so your mod displays with a readable title in the [b]F9[/b] list.
[*] Avoid bundling unmodified vanilla files so your mod stays lightweight and collision-free in the [b]Conflict Inspector[/b].
[*] Players can also drop local packs into [code]<Game Dir>\media_overrides\<PackName>\[/code] (or [i].zip[/i]).
[/list]
guaranteesSection:
[h1]Five-Year Plan Guarantees (Zero-Alloc & Save-Safe)[/h1][list]
[*] [b]Early-Boot Indexing:[/b] Builds the immutable VFS table synchronously at startup before [i]SOVIET64.exe[/i] parses core [i].ini[/i] files.
[*] [b]Zero-Alloc, Lock-Free Hot Path:[/b] Uses stack buffers and an immutable [i]wstring_view[/i] map—zero heap allocations and zero mutex locks inside [i]CreateFileW[/i] / [i]GetFileAttributesW[/i].
[*] [b]100% Non-Destructive:[/b] Original files in [i]media_soviet\[/i] are never modified.
[/list]
